verdicts.reason: A and B are practically the same layout, with only pixel-level shifts in the dark logo panel and the body text, so they share the same flaws. The dark logo block touches the top edge but floats off the left edge and takes up a large share of the canvas. The orange divider sits stranded above the 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow, and that eyebrow now sits under the logo panel instead of introducing the headline, which breaks the reading order. On the right, the body copy is cramped against the right edge, the legal text is too small to read, and the CTA is crowded between them.
